outcome.technical: CUTS, all in declared files. (1) _scoped_commit.head_sha(git_root) is a HEAD memo bound to the ref files. It reads HEAD from the tree's own git dir (_own_git_dir checks the .git entry against git's common dir: a .git directory, a submodule gitdir file, or a linked-worktree gitdir whose commondir leads back). Then it reads the branch's loose ref, or packed-refs when there is no loose ref. It reuses git's answer only while those bytes name the same commit, and it keeps an answer only when git named exactly the commit the files name. Nothing is kept for reftable, a symbolic loose ref, a ref outside refs/heads/ or unreadable files. The witness is read before git is asked. The two place lookups use git_place under the keys _locks.lock_dir and the tree-top callers already use. Callers: drive-phase.git_head now delegates to it. audit-task._examined_head and _phase_entry's HEAD use it (the latter replaces rev-parse --verify -q HEAD, with the same refusal on an unborn branch). _phase_entry's --show-toplevel now goes through hc.git_place. (2) _scoped_commit._tracking now takes a list of rels. It makes one `ls-files -z -- <specs>` listing and matches each plain pathspec back as the path itself or a path under it. Wildcards, magic prefixes, ./.. segments, backslashes and non-ASCII names are asked alone. A refused shared listing falls back to one listing per path. plugin_owned_rels is still its only caller, and the sc-ua13 fixture's args prefix still matches. (3) _tree_stamp._content_reading makes one `ls-files -z -t -s --cached --modified --deleted --others --exclude-standard` listing instead of two. The -t tags split it (_LISTED: H/S/M are index lines, C/R/? differ), and an unknown tag or a C/R line with no tab is a refusal. testsAdded: sc-hd1..sc-hd9 (test__scoped_commit.py): head_sha matches fresh git after a commit, a branch switch, a detached HEAD, a move written only in packed-refs and a loose ref outranking it, in a linked worktree, on an unborn branch, in a submodule and in reftable (skipped where git cannot make one). sc-hd1 is the other direction: three asks with nothing moved send git one question.

gh1 (test_drive_phase.py, sb-block): the driver's git_head follows a commit made between two asks in one process, and three unchanged asks send git one question.
